raw_articles.title: AWS Open Sources Kiro Crew for Asynchronous Coding Agents
raw_articles.summary: Amazon recently announced Kiro Crew, an open-source system for running multiple Kiro coding agents across sessions, tools, and tasks. The new workspace lets developers assign asynchronous coding tasks to AI agents, allowing work such as incident investigation, ticket triage, migrations, and PR monitoring to continue without active supervision. By Renato Losio
